description: Scala source code for Spark SQL Data Source examples, demonstrating various data reading and writing techniques including Parquet, JSON, CSV, Text, JDBC, and XML, with multiple example methods and usage of SparkSession.

classes.name: Person
classes.description: Case class representing a person with name and age fields.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main method initializing SparkSession and running various data source examples.

methods.name: runGenericFileSourceOptionsExample
methods.description: Demonstrates reading files with options like ignoreCorruptFiles, recursiveFileLookup, pathGlobFilter, modifiedBefore, and modifiedAfter.

methods.name: runBasicDataSourceExample
methods.description: Shows basic load and save operations with different formats and options, including SQL queries.

methods.name: runBasicParquetExample
methods.description: Reads and writes Parquet files, including creating views and querying.

methods.name: runParquetSchemaMergingExample
methods.description: Demonstrates schema merging with partitioned Parquet data.

methods.name: runJsonDatasetExample
methods.description: Reads JSON data into DataFrames and creates temporary views with SQL.

methods.name: runCsvDatasetExample
methods.description: Reads CSV data with various options and writes CSV files.

methods.name: runTextDatasetExample
methods.description: Reads text files with options like lineSep and wholetext, and writes text data.

methods.name: runJdbcDatasetExample
methods.description: Shows reading from and writing to JDBC sources with options and properties.

methods.name: runXmlDatasetExample
methods.description: Reads XML data with specified rowTag and creates views for SQL queries.
